english_text: I showed sincerity by cutting myself off from everything but Thee.
I approached Thee with my whole self.

arabic_text: وَصَـرَفْتُ وَجْهِي عَمَّنْ يَحْتَاجُ إلَى رِفْدِكَ،
transliteration: waṣarraftu wajhī ʿammān yaḥtāju ilā rifdika
english_text: I averted my face from everyone who needs Thy support.

arabic_text: وَقَلَبْتُ مَسْأَلَتِي عَمَّنْ لَمْ يَسْتَغْنِ عَنْ فَضْلِكَ،
transliteration: wa qalabtu mas'ālatī 'ammān lam yastaghni 'an fadlik
english_text: I ceased to ask from any who cannot do without Thy bounty.

arabic_text: وَرَأَيْتُ أَنَّ طَلَبَ الْمُحْتَاجِ إلَى الْمُحْتَاجِ سَفَهٌ مِنْ رَأيِهِ وَضَلَّةٌ مِنْ عَقْلِهِ،
transliteration: wa ra'aytu anna talaba al-muhtaaji ila al-muhtaaj safahun min ra'yihi waḍallatun min ʿaqlihi
english_text: I saw that the needy who seeks from the needy is foolish in his opinion, and misguided in his intellect.

arabic_text: فَكَمْ قَدْ رَأَيْتُ يَـا إلهِيْ مِنْ أُناس طَلَبُوا الْعِزَّ بِغَيْرِكَ فَذَلُّوا، وَرَامُوا الثَّرْوَةَ مِنْ سِوَاكَ فَافْتَقَرُوا، وَحَاوَلُوا الارْتِفَاعَ فَاتَّضَعُوا،
transliteration: fakam qad ra'aytu yaa ilaahi min ʾunās ṭalabū al-ʿizz bi-ghayrika faḏallū warāmū al-tharwah min siwāka fa-aftaqarū waḥāwalo al-irtifāʿa fa-attadaʿū
english_text: How many people have I seen, my God, who sought exaltation through other than Thee and were abased, who wanted wealth from someone else and became poor, who tried to rise high and fell down low!
Observing the likes of them corrects a prudent man;
his taking heed gives him success;

transliteration: wa ʾarshadahu ʾilá ṭarīqi ṣawābihi bi-iḫtibārihi
english_text: his choosing the best guides him to the path of right.

arabic_text: فَأَنْتَ يَا مَوْلايَ دُونَ كُلِّ مَسْؤُول مَوْضِعُ مَسْأَلَتِي وَدُونَ كُلِّ مَطْلُوب إلَيْهِ وَلِيُّ حَاجَتِي.
transliteration: fa'anta ya mawlaya dūna kulli mas'ūl mawḍiʿu mas'alatī wa dūna kulli maṭlūbin ilayhi wa waliyyu ḥājatī
english_text: So Thou, my Master, art the object of my asking to the exclusion of all those who are asked and the patron of my need to the exclusion of all those from whom requests are made.
Thou art singled out for my call before all who are called;

arabic_text: لاَ يَشْرَكُكَ أَحَدٌ فِي رَجَائِي، وَلاَ يَتَّفِقُ أَحَدٌ مَعَكَ فِي دُعَائِي، وَلاَ يَنْظِمُهُ وَإيَّاكَ نِدَائِي
transliteration: lā yashrakuka ʾaḥadun fī rajāʾī wa lā yattafiq'u ʾaḥadun maʿaka fī duʿāʾī walā yanẓimuhu wa-iyyāka nidā’ī
english_text: none is associated with Thee in my hope, none comes along with Thee in my supplication, nor does any join with Thee within it, for to Thee is my appeal.

arabic_text: لَكَ يَا إلهِي وَحْدَانِيَّةُ الْعَدَدِ، وَمَلَكَةُ الْقُدْرَةِ الصَّمَدِ، وَفَضِيلَةُ الْحَوْلِ وَالْقُوَّةِ، وَدَرَجَةُ الْعُلُوِّ وَالرِّفْعَةِ
transliteration: laka ya ilāhī waḥdāniyyatu al-ʿadad wa malakatu al-qudrah al-ṣamad wa faḍīlatu al-ḥawli wal-qūwwati wadarajatu al-ʿuluwwi wal-rrifʿati
english_text: To Thee, my God, belongs the Unity of number, the property of eternal power, the excellence of force and strength, the degree of sublimity and elevation.

arabic_text: وَمَنْ سِوَاكَ مَرْحُومٌ فِي عُمْرِهِ، مَغْلُوبٌ عَلَى أَمْرِهِ، مَقْهُورٌ عَلَى شَأنِهِ، مُخْتَلِفُ الْحَالاَتِ، مُتَنَقِّلٌ فِي الصِّفَاتِ.
transliteration: wa man siwaka marhūmun fī ʿumrih maghloobun ʿalaa amrih, maqhooorun ʿalaa shaʾnihi mukhtalif al-ḥalāt, mutanaqquil fi aṣ-ṣifāt
english_text: Everyone other than Thee is the object of compassion in his lifetime, overcome in his affair, overwhelmed in his situation, diverse in states, constantly changing in attributes.

arabic_text: فَتَعَالَيْتَ عَنِ الأشْبَاهِ وَالاضْـدَادِ، وَتَكَبَّـرْتَ عَنِ الأمْثَـالِ وَالأنْدَادِ،
transliteration: fataʿālayta ʿani al-ashbāhi wal-adad wa takabbartu ʿani al-amthāl wa al-andād
english_text: So Thou art high exalted above likenesses and opposites, proudly magnified beyond similitudes and rivals!

transliteration: fa subḥānaka lā ʾilaha ʾilla anta
english_text: Glory be to Thee! There is no God but Thou.
